tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what to play with friends, family or kids at home, games for the TV without a console, party games where phones are controllers, or games to play with friends far away. Given the number of players (and optionally the mood), returns up to 8 matching PadConsole games with pl

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for a kind of game by theme or keyword rather than by group size, for example football, racing, fighting, horror, quiz or trivia, bluffing, impostor, drawing, dance or motion, zombies, pirates, music. Returns matching PadConsole games with links. Does not start a game.

tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one specific PadConsole game (player count, genre, what it is like, whether friends in other homes can join). Takes a game id returned by another tool or a title. Returns a description and a link to the game page.

tools.name: explain_how_it_works
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how to start, what equipment or devices are needed (TV, laptop, phones, camera), or how friends in different homes can play together. Returns the steps and the link to open.
